interactive in Abaqus/Viewer: File > Run Script, or Plug-ins > Image export > Save current view — once per picture

Alternatives to 2a: MODE = "capture" in A_2_Image_export_Auto.py (pictures printed in Abaqus, read from abaqus.rpy), or VIEWS / VARIABLES edited in the script.
Order: 1 → 2a → 2b. 2a needs 1 only for the curve lists; 2b needs the settings of 2a and, for the curves, the results database of 1.
